FiscalYearConvention.description:
What an annual period label means in this result.

v1 receipts are UK results, so the convention is the UK fiscal year: year
Y is the period from 6 April Y to 5 April Y+1. Another convention needs a
new schema version.

A reviewer's acceptance of a regional release on another model version.

Written only by ``certify-data --accept-regional-model-mismatch``: the
regional release neither was built with nor claims the certified model,
and area runs on it are uncertified.

RegionalInputSurfaceEvidence.description:
An operator's audit of actual regional columns against an exact model.

Surfaces are retained so certification recomputes the comparison rather
than trusting a declared zero-loss result. The artifact hashes identify
the bytes inspected by the auditor, not merely a model's possible inputs.

title: ExecutionReceipt

x-policyengine-digests.canonicalization: RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) over the stated value after removing object members whose value is null (array elements are kept). Numbers are IEEE 754 doubles; integers must lie within +/-(2**53 - 1).
x-policyengine-digests.execution_identity_sha256: {schema_version, country_id, wrapper, model, core, data, certification_status, certificate?, regional_certification?} where certificate keeps only bundle_version, country_id, certificate_sha256, compatibility_basis, certified_for_model_version, certified_for_core_version, certified_dataset_sha256 and certified_by
x-policyengine-digests.outputs_sha256: the canonical output payload the receipt binds
x-policyengine-digests.receipt_sha256: the whole receipt without runtime and without reform.name and baseline.name
x-policyengine-digests.reform.reform_sha256: RFC 8785 over {representation, payload} where payload is the reform exactly as given in that representation, nulls kept (a null in a reform can mean something, unlike an absent receipt field); for policyengine-uk.scenario_composition/v1 the payload is {applied_before_data_load, application: parameter_changes_then_modifiers, members: [{representation, reform_sha256, binding}, ...]} with members in application order; an infinite number in a payload is the object {"$nonfinite": "Infinity"} or {"$nonfinite": "-Infinity"}, and a payload may not use the key $nonfinite itself

x-policyengine-rules: years is sorted ascending with no duplicates, and each year is written as an integer (2027, not 2027.0).

supported_years is sorted ascending with no duplicates. A year in years that is not in supported_years is unsupported: the model does not project the dataset to it, so a consumer must show its results as provisional or not at all.
certification_status certified requires certificate; uncertified forbids it.
reform/baseline kind current_law has no representation or reform_sha256 and binding content; kind reform has both.
wheel_sha256 and wheel_sha256_evidence are present together or not at all.

certification_status certified requires each of wrapper, model and core to have install_origin absent or archive, or install_origin directory or vcs with wheel_sha256_evidence installed_record_verified; an editable install is never certified.

A consumer trusts a certificate only after checking it against the data_releases.<country_id> record of the published policyengine manifest for certificate.bundle_version (verify_certificate()): certificate_sha256 is that record's digest, every other member of certificate except certificate_source, qualification_receipt_sha256 and tro_composition_fingerprint equals what the record states, and data equals the data identity the record determines. certificate_source is the producer's statement and proves nothing.
